original_text:
5.1  Performance security. The Contractor shall furnish a performance
security in a form acceptable to the Authority, equal to 5% of the
Contract Price, valid until 90 days after the end of the Defect Liability
Period.
rewrite_text: 5.1 Performance security. The Contractor shall furnish an irrevocable Performance Guarantee as a Bank Guarantee Bond per CPWD GCC Section 104, equal to 5% of the Contract Price and valid until 90 days after the end of the Defect Liability Period.
rewrite_explanation: The rewrite clarifies the vague 'form acceptable to the Authority' by specifying the method as an 'irrevocable Performance Guarantee' and the standard as a 'Bank Guarantee Bond per CPWD GCC Section 104'. This directly resolves the bidder's uncertainty regarding the acceptable forms and prescribed formats for the security.
